data.title: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg sides with Nvidia's Huang on AI safety and slowdown debate
data.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's view of artificial intelligence safety is akin to the perspective of Nvidia's Jensen Huang rather than Anthropic chief Dario Amodei.
